metadata.description: Atalaia phase 2 (Field network), DESIGN ONLY. Scope from docs/design-spec.md section 16: the LoRa protocol (Skirmesh-RF), time sync, log merge, the Raspberry Pi field controller, the MQTT and REST API, the GM console web app, and an example scoreboard. Gate: 5 boxes on a CQB site and an outdoor field, with zero lost captures.
